data.narrative:
Rugged Robotics is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company founded by Derrick J. Morse and Logan Farrell that has raised $12M to date. Valuation analysis incorporates a comparison universe of nine private companies and one public comparable (277810.KQ), primarily at Series A and Series B stages, including peers such as Humanoid, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, Generalist AI, and Walden Robotics.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy for post-money valuation, applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, yielding $24M. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables yields $1.6B, with a range spanning $1.1B (Walden Robotics, Seed) to $2.0B (Generalist AI, Series B).

The wide dispersion between methods—$24M versus $1.6B—reflects structural uncertainty in early-stage robotics valuations. The triangulated range is $20.4M (low) to $1.9B (high), with median of $837M. The peer-median result carries elevated weight given the five-company dataset, though the presence of later-stage companies (Series B valuations at $1.6B–$2.0B) may overstate early-stage value. Stage-progression likely underweights Rugged Robotics if founders have demonstrated technical or market traction beyond capital deployed. Key uncertainties include whether comparable exits justify current peer valuations and whether Rugged Robotics' specific product-market fit justifies positioning within the observed peer band.
